lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/files: 53,052 B in 20 modules on the libresign-init page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 29,286 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
libresign-main: 2,520 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B, generated by vite 197 B.
libresign-external: 2,509 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B, generated by vite 197 B.
libresign-settings: 197 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 197 B.
libresign-validation: 2,509 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B, generated by vite 197 B.
libresign-init: 3,831 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 1,996 B, @vueuse/shared 832 B, @nextcloud/paths 719 B.
All 6 pages load the same 1 file: 183,219 B raw, 70,441 B gzip, 51.3 % of the smallest page (libresign-tab, 357,499 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 65,941 B, dompurify 30,482 B, @vue/runtime-dom 28,058 B, @vue/reactivity 18,394 B, @vue/shared 14,174 B.
moment, 301,445 B on the libresign-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,293 B on the libresign-init page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,627 B in 2 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
